GWS.ASSUREDCONTROLS.1.2v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHOULD restrict support access to U.S.-based Google staff only.

GWS.ASSUREDCONTROLS.2.1v1.baseline_text: Data processing across multiple regions SHOULD be disabled for all Google Workspace products.

GWS.CALENDAR.1.1v1.baseline_text: External sharing options for primary calendars SHALL be configured to "Only free/busy information (hide event details)."

GWS.CALENDAR.1.2v1.baseline_text: External sharing options for secondary calendars SHALL be configured to "Only free/busy information (hide event details)."

GWS.CALENDAR.2.1v1.baseline_text: External invitations warnings SHALL be enabled to prompt users before sending invitations.

GWS.CALENDAR.3.2v1.baseline_text: Microsoft 365 (Graph API) SHALL be used instead of basic authentication to establish connectivity between tenants or organizations in cases where Calendar Interop is deemed necessary for agency mission fulfillment.

GWS.CALENDAR.4.1v1.baseline_text: "Appointment Schedule with Payments" SHOULD be disabled.

GWS.CHAT.1.1v1.baseline_text: Chat history SHALL be enabled for information traceability.

GWS.CHAT.1.2v1.baseline_text: Users SHALL NOT be allowed to change their history setting.

GWS.CHAT.2.1v1.baseline_text: External file sharing SHALL be disabled to protect sensitive information from unauthorized or accidental sharing.

GWS.CHAT.3.1v1.baseline_text: Space history SHOULD be enabled for information traceability.

GWS.CHAT.4.1v1.baseline_text: External chat messaging SHALL be restricted to allowlisted domains only.

GWS.CHAT.5.1v1.baseline_text: Chat content reporting SHALL be enabled for all conversation types.

GWS.CHAT.5.2v1.baseline_text: All reporting message categories SHOULD be selected.

GWS.CLASSROOM.1.1v1.baseline_text: "Who can join classes in your domain" SHOULD be set to "Users in your domain only."

GWS.CLASSROOM.1.2v1.baseline_text: "Which classes users in your domain can join" SHOULD be set to "Classes in your domain only."

GWS.CLASSROOM.2.1v1.baseline_text: Users SHOULD NOT be able to authorize apps to access their Google Classroom data.

GWS.CLASSROOM.3.1v1.baseline_text: "Roster Import" with Clever SHOULD be turned off.

GWS.CLASSROOM.4.1v1.baseline_text: Only teachers SHOULD be allowed to unenroll students from classes.

GWS.CLASSROOM.5.1v1.baseline_text: Class creation SHOULD be restricted to verified teachers only.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.1.1v1.baseline_text: Phishing-Resistant MFA SHALL be required for all users.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.1.2v1.baseline_text: If phishing-resistant MFA has not been enforced, an alternative MFA method SHALL be enforced for all users.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.1.3v1.baseline_text: SMS or Voice SHALL NOT be used as the MFA method.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.1.4v1.baseline_text: The Google 2-Step Verification (2SV) new user enrollment period SHALL be set to at least one day and at most one week.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.1.5v1.baseline_text: Allow users to trust the device SHALL be disabled.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.10.1v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHALL use GWS application access control policies to restrict access to all GWS services by third-party applications.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.10.2v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHALL NOT allow users to grant consent for access to low-risk scopes.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.10.3v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHALL NOT trust unconfigured internal applications.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.10.4v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHALL NOT allow users to access unconfigured third-party applications.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.10.5v1.baseline_text: Access to GWS applications by less secure applications that do not meet security authentication standards SHALL be prevented.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.11.1v1.baseline_text: Only approved Google Workspace (GWS) Marketplace applications SHALL be allowed for installation.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.12.1v1.baseline_text: Google Takeout services SHALL be disabled.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.13.1v1.baseline_text: Required system-defined alerting rules, as listed in the policy group description, SHALL be enabled with alerts.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.14.1v1.baseline_text: The following critical logs SHALL be sent to the agency's centralized SIEM.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.14.2v1.baseline_text: Audit logs SHALL be retained and searchable for a minimum of 3 months and retrievable for a minimum of 12 months.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.15.1v1.baseline_text: The data storage region SHALL be set to be the United States for all users in the agency's GWS environment.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.15.2v1.baseline_text: Data SHALL be processed in the region selected for data at rest.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.16.1v1.baseline_text: Service status for Google services that do not have an individual control SHOULD be set to OFF for everyone.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.16.2v1.baseline_text: User access to Early Access applications SHOULD be disabled.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.16.3v1.baseline_text: Looker Studio Sharing outside org SHOULD be set to OFF.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.16.4v1.baseline_text: Pinpoint access to drive SHOULD be set to OFF.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.17.1v1.baseline_text: Require multi-party approval for sensitive admin actions SHOULD be enabled.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.18.1v1.baseline_text: A custom policy SHALL be configured for Google Drive, Google Calendar, Google Chat, and Gmail to protect PII and sensitive information as defined by the agency, covering at a minimum: credit card numbers, U.S. Individual Taxpayer Identification Numbers (ITIN), and U.S. Social Security numbers (SSN).

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.18.2v1.baseline_text: The action for DLP policies SHOULD be set to block.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.2.1v1.baseline_text: Policies restricting access to Google Workspace (GWS) based on enterprise device signals SHOULD be implemented.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.3.1v1.baseline_text: Post-single sign-on (SSO) verification SHOULD be enabled for users signing in using the organization's SSO profile.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.3.2v1.baseline_text: Post-SSO verification SHOULD be enabled for users signing in using other SSO profiles.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.4.1v1.baseline_text: Users SHALL be forced to re-authenticate after an established 12-hour GWS login session has expired.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.5.1v1.baseline_text: User password strength SHALL be enforced.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.5.2v1.baseline_text: User password length SHALL be at least 12 characters.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.5.3v1.baseline_text: User password length SHOULD be at least 16 characters.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.5.4v1.baseline_text: Password policy SHALL be enforced at next sign-in.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.5.5v1.baseline_text: User passwords SHALL NOT be reused.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.6.1v1.baseline_text: All administrative accounts SHALL be provisioned as cloud-only accounts separate from an agency's authoritative on-premises or other federated identity providers.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.6.2v1.baseline_text: A minimum of **two** and a maximum of **eight** separate and distinct super admin users SHALL be configured.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.7.1v1.baseline_text: Account conflict management SHOULD be configured to replace conflicting unmanaged accounts with managed accounts.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.8.1v1.baseline_text: Account self-recovery for super admins SHALL be disabled.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.8.2v1.baseline_text: Account self-recovery for users and non-super admins SHALL be disabled.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.8.3v1.baseline_text: Ability to add recovery information SHOULD be disabled.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.9.1v1.baseline_text: Highly privileged accounts SHALL be enrolled in the Google Workspace (GWS) Advanced Protection Program.

GWS.COMMONCONTROLS.9.2v1.baseline_text: All sensitive user accounts SHOULD be enrolled into the GWS Advanced Protection Program.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.10v1.baseline_text: If external sharing is not allowed, then forms owned by users within the organization SHOULD NOT be able to accept responses from anyone accessing the link from outside the organization.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.11v1.baseline_text: If receiving external files is not allowed, then users in the organization SHOULD NOT be able to submit responses to forms from users or shared drives outside of the organization.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.1v1.baseline_text: External sharing SHALL be restricted to allowlisted domains.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.2v1.baseline_text: Receiving files from non-allowlisted domains SHOULD be disabled.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.3v1.baseline_text: Warnings SHALL be enabled when a user is attempting to share with someone in a non-allowlisted domain.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.4v1.baseline_text: If sharing outside of the organization, agencies SHOULD disable sharing of files with individuals who are not using a Google account.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.5v1.baseline_text: Any Organizational Units that allow external sharing SHOULD disable content availability to "anyone with the link."

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.6v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHALL set access checking to "recipients only."

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.7v1.baseline_text: Users SHOULD NOT be allowed to upload or move content to shared drives owned by another organization.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.8v1.baseline_text: "Private to owner" SHALL be the default access level for newly created items.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.1.9v1.baseline_text: Out-of-Domain file-level warnings SHALL be enabled.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.2.1v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHOULD NOT allow members with manager access to override shared Google Drive creation settings.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.2.2v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHALL allow users who are not members of a shared Google Drive to be added to files.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.3.1v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHALL enable the security update for Google Drive files.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.4.1v1.baseline_text: Agencies SHOULD disable Google Drive SDK access.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.5.1v1.baseline_text: Google Drive for Desktop SHALL be enabled for authorized devices only.

GWS.DRIVEDOCS.5.2v1.baseline_text: Monitoring for potential ransomware corruption SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GEMINI.1.1v1.baseline_text: Gemini app user access SHALL be set to OFF for everyone without a license.

GWS.GEMINI.2.1v1.baseline_text: Gemini Beta features SHALL be disabled.

GWS.GEMINI.3.1v1.baseline_text: Gemini conversation history SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GEMINI.3.2v1.baseline_text: Gemini conversation retention SHALL be set to minimum of 18 months.

GWS.GEMINI.4.1v1.baseline_text: Conversation sharing SHALL be set to OFF.

GWS.GMAIL.10.1v1.baseline_text: Google Workspace Sync SHOULD be disabled.

GWS.GMAIL.11.1v1.baseline_text: Automatic forwarding SHOULD be disabled, especially to external domains.

GWS.GMAIL.12.1v1.baseline_text: The option to use a per-user outbound gateway that is a mail server other than the Google Workspace (GWS) mail servers SHALL be disabled.

GWS.GMAIL.13.1v1.baseline_text: Unintended external reply warnings SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.14.1v1.baseline_text: An email allowlist SHOULD NOT be implemented.

GWS.GMAIL.15.1v1.baseline_text: Enhanced pre-delivery message scanning SHALL be enabled to prevent phishing.

GWS.GMAIL.16.1v1.baseline_text: Security sandbox SHOULD be enabled to provide additional email protections.

GWS.GMAIL.17.1v1.baseline_text: Comprehensive mail storage SHOULD be enabled to allow information traceability across applications.

GWS.GMAIL.18.1v1.baseline_text: Domains SHALL NOT be added to lists that bypass spam filters.

GWS.GMAIL.18.2v1.baseline_text: Domains SHALL NOT be added to lists that bypass spam filters and hide warnings.

GWS.GMAIL.18.3v1.baseline_text: "Bypass spam filters" and "hide warnings for all messages from internal and external senders" SHALL NOT be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.2.1v1.baseline_text: DKIM SHOULD be enabled for all domains.

GWS.GMAIL.3.1v1.baseline_text: An SPF policy SHALL be published for each domain that fails all non-approved senders.

GWS.GMAIL.4.1v1.baseline_text: A DMARC policy SHALL be published at the full domain or the second-level domain for all Google Workspace domains, including user alias domains.

GWS.GMAIL.4.2v1.baseline_text: The DMARC message rejection option SHALL be p=reject.

GWS.GMAIL.4.3v1.baseline_text: The DMARC point of contact for aggregate reports SHALL include `reports@dmarc.cyber.dhs.gov`.

GWS.GMAIL.4.4v1.baseline_text: An agency point of contact SHOULD be included for aggregate and failure reports.

GWS.GMAIL.5.1v1.baseline_text: "Protect against encrypted attachments from untrusted senders" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.5.2v1.baseline_text: "Protect against attachments with scripts from untrusted senders" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.5.3v1.baseline_text: "Protect against anomalous attachment types in emails" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.5.4v1.baseline_text: Google SHOULD be allowed to automatically apply future recommended settings for attachments.

GWS.GMAIL.5.5v1.baseline_text: Emails flagged by SCuBA policies GWS.GMAIL.5.1 through GWS.GMAIL.5.3 SHALL NOT be kept in inbox.

GWS.GMAIL.6.1v1.baseline_text: "Identify links behind shortened URLs" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.6.3v1.baseline_text: "Show warning prompt for any click on links to untrusted domains" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.6.4v1.baseline_text: Google SHALL be allowed to automatically apply future recommended settings for links and external images.

GWS.GMAIL.7.1v1.baseline_text: "Protect against domain spoofing based on similar domain names" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.7.2v1.baseline_text: "Protect against spoofing of employee names" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.7.3v1.baseline_text: "Protect against inbound emails spoofing your domain" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.7.4v1.baseline_text: "Protect against any unauthenticated emails" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.7.5v1.baseline_text: "Protect your Groups from inbound emails spoofing your domain" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.GMAIL.7.6v1.baseline_text: Emails flagged by SCuBA policies GWS.GMAIL.7.1 through GWS.GMAIL.7.5 SHALL NOT be kept in inbox.

GWS.GMAIL.7.7v1.baseline_text: Google SHALL be allowed to automatically apply future recommended settings for spoofing and authentication.

GWS.GMAIL.8.1v1.baseline_text: User email uploads SHALL be disabled to protect against unauthorized files being introduced into the secured environment.

GWS.GMAIL.9.1v1.baseline_text: POP and IMAP access SHALL be disabled to protect sensitive agency or organization emails from being accessed through legacy applications or other third-party mail clients.

GWS.GROUPS.1.1v1.baseline_text: Group access from outside the organization SHALL be disabled unless explicitly granted by the group owner.

GWS.GROUPS.1.2v1.baseline_text: Group owners' ability to add external members to groups SHOULD be disabled unless necessary for agency mission fulfillment.

GWS.GROUPS.1.3v1.baseline_text: Group owners' ability to allow external, non-group members to post in the group SHOULD be disabled unless necessary for agency mission fulfillment.

GWS.GROUPS.2.1v1.baseline_text: Group creation SHOULD be restricted to administrators within the organization unless alternative creators are necessary for agency mission fulfillment.

GWS.GROUPS.3.1v1.baseline_text: The default permission to view conversations SHOULD be set to "All group members."

GWS.GROUPS.4.1v1.baseline_text: The ability for groups to be hidden from the directory SHALL be disabled.

GWS.MEET.1.1v1.baseline_text: External users who were not explicitly invited to a Google Meet meeting SHALL be required to ask to join.

GWS.MEET.2.1v1.baseline_text: Meeting access SHALL be disabled for meetings created by users who are not members of any Google Workspace (GWS) tenant or organization.

GWS.MEET.3.1v1.baseline_text: Host management meeting features SHALL be enabled.

GWS.MEET.4.1v1.baseline_text: "Warn for external participants" SHALL be enabled.

GWS.MEET.5.1v1.baseline_text: Automatic recordings for Google Meet SHALL be disabled.

GWS.MEET.5.2v1.baseline_text: Automatic transcripts for Google Meet SHALL be disabled.

GWS.MEET.6.1v1.baseline_text: Administrators SHOULD NOT be allowed to override the default sharing level for meeting notes set by the organization.

GWS.MEET.6.2v1.baseline_text: Default sharing setting for Google AI notes SHALL be restricted to "Guests in your organization."

GWS.MEET.6.3v1.baseline_text: Screenshots of presented content SHALL only captured in notes when recording is enabled.

GWS.SITES.1.1v1.baseline_text: Sites Service SHOULD be disabled for all users.
